information: This competition is supported by [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/) as the Texas State Championship for 2026 - We're excited to bring speedcubing back to San Antonio for the 5th annual Texas Championship! While only residents of Texas are eligible for the title of Texas State Champion, all competitors are welcome and encouraged to compete! More information can be found on the [Texas Champion Titles tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasChampionship2026#75988-texas-champion-titles). All competitors must read the [Important Information/FAQ tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasChampionship2026#75986-important-information-faq) prior to registering. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE5MDY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--57bcfd77939cc9fb4ddb721cbc3aba13235c8d44/TXC2026PinkLogo.png) Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasChampionship2026#competition-schedule) is tentative - we may adjust the exact starting time of each event based on the final number of registered competitors. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTA5ODQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d90b474725899b23c9c5d15d90dc03063159a03c/southernCubing.png)
